fact: Failure to follow Race Directors instruction.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the International Sporting Code and noncompliance with Race Director's Competition Note (item 13.6, document 56) – Practice start infringement at 14:20.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 6 (Isack Hadjar), team representative and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, telemetry, team radio and in-car video evidence. During the reconnaissance laps, HAD approached the Pit Exit where several cars were ahead of him. HAD did not ultimately perform a practice start. Paragraph 13.6 of the Race Director's Competition Notes requires a car not wishing to perform a practice start to cross the white line separating the Pit Exit Road from the track at the earliest opportunity and join the normal racing line. Instead, HAD remained within the Pit Exit Road and passed to the right of the cars ahead before joining the track. The Stewards therefore determine that HAD failed to follow the Race Director's instructions. The Stewards nevertheless considered that there were mitigating circumstances. HAD had initially intended to perform a practice start himself, but had to abort that attempt quite late and restart. The Stewards accepted that this sequence contributed to the driver being distracted and to his failure to follow the prescribed procedure. While the driver remains responsible for complying with the Race Director's instructions, the Stewards considered these circumstances sufficient to mitigate the penalty. Having also considered comparable previous incidents, the Stewards therefore determine that a Warning, rather than a Driving Reprimand, is appropriate.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 6 Failing To Follow Race Directors Instructions Practice Start
